title: Dual line receiver (open collector)

sources.document: TI The Interface Circuits Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1974, SN55107A/SN55108A/SN75107A/SN75108A (bulletin DL-S 7111224, Feb 1971)

pins.name: 1G
pins.text: strobe for channel 1: when 1G or S is low the output is high

functions.text: Output low only when the differential input is negative (A below B by at least 25 mV) and both strobes are high; high otherwise.

electrical.notes: VCC+ 4.75-5.25 V, VCC- -4.75 to -5.25 V, TA 0-70 C. Receiver input thresholds: VIDH 25 mV (output high when A-B >= +25 mV), VIDL -25 mV; between them the output is indeterminate when both strobes are high. Differential input range -5 to +5 V, common-mode range -3 to +3 V. Strobe inputs: VIH 2 V, VIL 0.8 V. Open collector: IOH max 250 uA at VOH = VCC+ max; outputMaxVoltageV is that VCC+ max (5.25 V), no higher pull-up voltage is stated.

timing.conditions: VCC+ 5 V, VCC- -5 V, TA 25 C, RL 390 ohm, CL 15 pF
VCC+ 5 V, VCC- -5 V, TA 25 C, RL 390 ohm, CL 15 pF
VCC+ 5 V, VCC- -5 V, TA 25 C, RL 390 ohm, CL 15 pF
VCC+ 5 V, VCC- -5 V, TA 25 C, RL 390 ohm, CL 15 pF

unknown: Recommended IOH is not stated for the open-collector output (only leakage 250 uA max), so outputHighMaxCurrentMa is null.
Datasheet read is the improved 'A' version (SN75107A/SN75108A), described as a direct replacement for the original; the original non-A datasheet was not read.
notes: Truth table: VID >= 25 mV -> H; -25 < VID < 25 mV -> H unless both G and S high (then indeterminate); VID <= -25 mV -> L only with G and S both high. When only one channel is used, ground the other channel's inputs.
